dashboard.label: Executive SOC Overview
dashboard.description: Centralized operational view of security activity across network telemetry, IDS alerts, Windows Security logs, and HTTP traffic.

search.query: | inputlookup Total_Events.csv | rename "Total Events" AS total_events | stats max(total_events) AS value
| inputlookup Total_IDS_Alerts.csv | rename "IDS Alerts" AS ids_alerts | stats max(ids_alerts) AS value
| inputlookup Windows_Events.csv | rename "Windows Events" AS windows_events | stats max(windows_events) AS value
| inputlookup HTTP_Requests.csv | rename "HTTP Requests" AS http_requests | stats max(http_requests) AS value
| inputlookup Events_Timeline.csv | eval _time=strptime(_time, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%3N%z") | timechart span=30m sum(count) AS events
| inputlookup alert_severity.csv | rename "alert.severity" AS severity | chart sum(count) AS detections by severity
| inputlookup Top_IDS_Signatures.csv | rename "alert.signature" AS signature | sort - count | head 10
